metrics.quote: Effective January 1, 2023, the Company changed its estimate of the useful life

drivers.text: Revenue up 112% on higher demand from existing and new customer contracts and delivery through an expanded data center footprint; about 93% of the increase came from existing customers.
Cost of revenue rose 181% mainly from data center expansion: rent up about $335 million and power/utilities up about $87 million.
Technology and infrastructure expense rose largely on about $752 million more depreciation and amortization from servers, switches and networking equipment placed in service.

Net interest expense rose 140% on increased borrowing and total debt; the company raised more than $10 billion of unsecured debt and convertible bonds in the period and a $3.1 billion delayed-draw term loan.
Management points to operating leverage beginning to show and accelerating customer demand; backlog about $104 billion excluding more than $25 billion of commitments added in early Q3.

gaps: capex_guidance: the release says forward-looking guidance will be given on the earnings call (line 85); no capex guidance figure is in the files.
rpo_next_12m_pct: the 10-Q gives 41% within the first 24 months (to Jun 30 2028), not a 12-month share.
cloud_segment_revenue_q / cloud_segment_op_income_q: CoreWeave reports a single segment, so total revenue and operating income are the cloud figures.
largest-customer identity: filing labels Customer A/B/C/D without names and notes letters may differ between periods.
contracted power and active power are release statements (company reporting), not in the 10-Q numeric tables; the 10-Q grep for GW found no match.
useful_life_change: the stated earnings impact in the 10-K is for 2023 only (reduction in total expenses of $20 million); no change in estimate found for 2025-2026 in the files read.
capex incl. finance leases: finance lease principal is minimal (33 for six months, financing cash flow line); quarter-only figure not disclosed.
Interest expense in the release is net of capitalized interest (capitalized interest 79 in Q2, 10-Q line 977).
